parties:
Abdul Baset Chowdhury and others ------ Appellants
vs
State ------ Respondent
full_judgment: SM Ziaul Karim J: This appeal at the instance of convict appellants, namely (1) Abdul Baset @ Bachchu Miah @ Abdul Baset Chowdhury @ Bachchu Chairman, (2) Azam, (3) Gias, (4) Shahidullah @ Shahid, (5) Haris, (6) Bakul, (7) Sadat Ali and (8) Faruk, is directed against the judgment and order dated 11-9-1994 passed by the learned Judge of the Santras Mulak Aparadh Daman Tribunal, Narsingdi in Santras Mulak Aparadh Daman Tribunal Case No. 2 of 1994 convicting the appellants under sections 4 and 5 of the Santras Mulak Aparadh Daman Act, 1992 and sentencing each of them to suffer rigorous imprisonment for five years and also to pay a fine of Taka 5,000, in default to suffer rigorous imprisonment for one month more and also convicting the appellants under sections 143, 448 and 379 of the Penal Code and sentencing each of them to suffer rigorous imprisonment for two months under section 143 of the Penal Code, rigorous imprisonment for three months under section 448 of the Penal Code and rigorous imprisonment for one year under section 379 of the Penal Code.
